metadata.title: Pseudolocality and strong uniqueness for complete Ricci flows
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we prove a uniform pseudolocality theorem for smooth complete Ricci flows whose initial metrics have Ricci curvature bounded below and uniformly positive injectivity radius. No a priori curvature bound is assumed on the flow. As a consequence, we obtain strong uniqueness for smooth complete Ricci flows from a complete metric with the above geometric bounds. We also prove that every smooth complete Ricci flow from a complete Ricci-flat metric with uniformly positive injectivity radius is stationary. The same conclusion holds for any complete flat initial metric. In particular, we give an affirmative answer to Chen's question on the strong uniqueness of Ricci flow from Euclidean space in every dimension.

analysis.progressType: 无预设曲率界的 Ricci 流强唯一性
analysis.workSummary: 作者宣称仅凭初始 Ricci 下界和统一正注入半径，即可使每个光滑完备 Ricci 流在统一短时间满足 |Rm|≤α/t，且 α 可任意指定。由此得到同初值流的短时间强唯一性；Ricci 平坦且不塌缩的初值及任意完备平坦初值所生流在整个存在期间保持静止。
techniques: 共轭热方程的 Dirichlet 穷竭
空间加权点选与重标度
analysis.breakthrough: 在不预设流的全局曲率界或 L-完备性下建立统一短时间曲率控制，并用于强唯一性。
analysis.limitations: 初始度量须光滑完备、Ric≥−K、注入半径≥i0>0，流的每个时间切片须完备；一般同初值流的推论直接给出的是统一短时间唯一性，平坦初值静止性则覆盖整个存在区间。
